'''Ooroo Canyon''' was a location on the [[planet]] [[Ossus]] mentioned in the [[Qel-Droma Epics]]. According to the Epics, the canyon shared its name with the [[Jedi Master]] [[Ooroo]], teacher of the [[Jedi]] [[Odan-Urr]]. After Ooroo's [[death]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War]], Odan-Urr supposedly constructed the [[Great Jedi Library]] on the canyon to honor a promise made to Ooroo.<ref name="NOP" />
